latest_release.body:
Codex with ChatGPT v0.1.4

ChatGPT thinks. Codex works.

v0.1.4 is a correctness and docs update: execution records can name which agent ran an iteration; Quick Tunnel setup waits before the first health probe so fresh hostnames are not negatively cached; search truncation is reported accurately; Windows Named Tunnel credential gaps get clearer doctor diagnostics; ChatGPT can inspect workspace images safely; and install docs honor `CODEX_HOME`.

The core model remains unchanged: ChatGPT plans and reviews; Codex owns execution. No API key. No reverse proxy. No cookies or session extraction.

This release closes / includes:

- #412 — record which executor ran an iteration
- #416 — Quick Tunnel DNS negative-cache trap
- #448 — search truncation accuracy
- #446 — Windows Named Tunnel credential diagnostics
- #435 — safe read-only media workflows
- #434 — Web GPT / catalog support boundary docs
- #443 — honor `CODEX_HOME` in install paths

✨ Highlights

- Executor-aware execution records (#412)
  
  - Optional `executor` on execution records and `c2c record --executor`
  - Tool descriptions no longer hard-code Codex as the only runner

- Safer Quick Tunnel startup on aggressive DNS caches (#416)
  
  - Wait before the first `/health` probe so a fresh `*.trycloudflare.com` hostname is not negatively cached
  - Overridable via `C2C_TUNNEL_HEALTH_INITIAL_DELAY_MS` / `C2C_TUNNEL_START_TIMEOUT_MS`

- Accurate search truncation (#448)
  
  - Ripgrep and Node fallback no longer silently drop matches or mark exact-limit results as truncated

- Windows Named Tunnel credential diagnostics (#446)
  
  - Read-only doctor checks for missing / unreadable / mismatched tunnel credentials
  - Clear next steps without auto-restoring secrets

- Read-only media workflows (#435)
  
  - MCP `read_image` for workspace PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/SVG with containment and size bounds
  - Local `c2c asset import` for validated images/videos into a new workspace path
  - Connector stays read-only; import is an explicit local-executor action

- Docs: Web GPT catalog boundary (#434) and `CODEX_HOME` paths (#443)

🔐 Safety & correctness

- No new MCP write tools or reverse-proxy / cookie / session-extraction behavior
- Media import rejects path escapes, overwrites, signature mismatches, and active SVG
- Named Tunnel credential recovery remains a user-confirmed step

🙌 Contributors

Special thanks to:

- @terryhappyhome — #412 executor-neutral records
- @mitre88 — #416 Quick Tunnel DNS delay
- @UV26is — #448 search truncation
- @Oscar-Williams — #446 Named Tunnel credential diagnostics
- @TribalHouse — #435 media workflows
- @OrdoAbChao7 — #434 Web GPT support boundary
- @Kerwin-k — #443 CODEX_HOME docs

---

中文

这是 v0.1.4，重点是执行记录可标注执行者、Quick Tunnel 避免 DNS 负缓存误判、搜索截断标记更准、Windows Named Tunnel 凭据诊断更清楚、只读媒体检查/导入，以及文档对齐 `CODEX_HOME`。

核心理念仍然没变：

«ChatGPT 负责思考，Codex 负责干活。»

本版合入：

- #412 记录本次迭代由哪个执行者完成
- #416 Quick Tunnel 首次 health 前等待，避开负缓存
- #448 搜索截断报告更准确
- #446 Windows Named Tunnel 凭据缺失只读诊断
- #435 只读读图 + 本地安全导入
- #434 Web GPT / 目录边界说明
- #443 文档尊重 `CODEX_HOME`

感谢 @terryhappyhome、@mitre88、@UV26is、@Oscar-Williams、@TribalHouse、@OrdoAbChao7、@Kerwin-k 以及所有贡献者。❤️

最重要的一点仍然是：

能让 Agent 自己完成的事情，就不要让用户完成。

detail.readme_excerpt:
# Codex with ChatGPT

> ChatGPT thinks. Codex works.
> ChatGPT 负责思考，Codex 负责干活。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **遇到问题？** 请先向 Codex 发送 **「更新 Codex with ChatGPT」** 并重试。更新到最新版本可以解决大多数已知问题。  
> **Having trouble?** First ask Codex to **“Update Codex with ChatGPT”** and try again. Updating to the latest version resolves most known issues.

## The problem · 解决什么问题

**中文** — ChatGPT 付费订阅的网页版额度大量闲置，Codex 却在消耗紧张的
API 额度做规划和 Review。本项目把"思考"交给你已付费的网页版 ChatGPT，
Codex 只负责执行。不用 API Key、不搞逆向代理——官方网页 + 只读 MCP 桥接。

**EN** — ChatGPT Plus/Pro web quota sits idle while your coding agent burns
scarce API/Codex tokens on planning and review. This project moves the
thinking to the subscription you already pay for; Codex only executes.
No API keys, no reverse proxy — official web UI plus a read-only MCP bridge.

## What it is · 这是什么

**中文** — 把 ChatGPT 网页版变成 Codex 编码会话的"规划与审查大脑"，执行权
完全保留在 Codex 手里。你的仓库永远不会被上传：ChatGPT 通过一条安全的、
OAuth 保护的**只读** MCP 连接，按需读取当前工作区里它真正需要的那几行代码。

**EN** — Use the ChatGPT web app as the planning and review brain for your
Codex coding sessions, while Codex keeps full ownership of execution. Your
repository is never uploaded: ChatGPT reads exactly the lines it needs through
a secure, OAuth-protected, **read-only** MCP connection to your current
workspace.

Detailed docs below are in English · 详细中文文档见 **[README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)**

## One-paste install · 一段话安装

**中文** — 不懂 git、Node、终端？完全不需要懂。把下面这段话原样复制给你的
编码 Agent（Codex），然后去倒杯咖啡：

```text
请帮我完整安装并配置 Codex with ChatGPT，全程自动，我是不懂技术的小白，
所有事情你自己做：

1. 环境自检：需要 git 和 Node.js ≥ 20，缺什么就自动安装
  （macOS 用 Homebrew，Windows 用 winget），同时安装 cloudflared。
2. 下载：把 https://github.com/XiaoDuoYa/codex-with-chatgpt 克隆到
   ~/codex-with-chatgpt（已存在就 git pull 更新）。
3. 构建：在该目录里执行 corepack pnpm install 和 corepack pnpm build。
4. 安装 Skill：先确定 Codex home：如果设置了非空的 CODEX_HOME 就使用它，
   否则使用 ~/.codex（Windows 默认为 %USERPROFILE%\.codex）。把仓库里的
   skill/SKILL.md 复制到 <codex-home>/skills/codex-with-chatgpt/SKILL.md，
   并把文件中 "The codex-with-chatgpt checkout lives at:" 那一行的路径改成实际克隆路径。
5. 首次配置：按 SKILL.md 里的 first-time setup 流程执行
  （运行 c2c setup，用内置浏览器打开 ChatGPT 配置连接器并输入配对码）。
   全程只用内置浏览器，禁止打开任何第三方浏览器。
6. 只有遇到需要我登录（ChatGPT / Cloudflare）、验证码或两步验证时才叫我，
   而且一次只告诉我一个动作。
7. 完成后给我看 ✓ 清单，并确认文件读取测试通过。我不懂 MCP、OAuth、
   Tunnel、端口这些词，不要向我解释；出了问题先自己修。
```

paragraph below, paste it to your coding agent (Codex), and go grab a coffee:

3. Build: inside that folder run `corepack pnpm install` then `corepack pnpm build`.
